name: molt
description: Context handoff as a Claude Code mod. molt warns the session at 40% and 50% of the context window to find a good point and hand off, tells it to hand off now at 65%, and past 75% lets only the handoff's own tools run. A root session is then cleared in the same pane and seeded with the handoff, so no successor session is launched; a child session (MOLT_HANDOFF=parent) is never cleared and hands off to its parent. Works in any terminal or orchestration layer. Requires Claude Code 2.1.289 or later.

warnPercent.title: First warning (% of the context window)
warnPercent.description: Past this fill the session is warned, once, to find a good point to hand off. Work continues.

warnAgainPercent.title: Second warning (% of the context window)
warnAgainPercent.description: Past this fill the session is told, once, that the handoff is past due. Work continues.

commandPercent.title: Handoff command (% of the context window)
commandPercent.description: Past this fill the session is told to write its handoff now. Unset: 65.

blockPercent.title: Block (% of the context window)
blockPercent.description: Past this fill only Write, Edit, Skill, git add and git commit run until the session hands off. Unset: 75.

fallbackMargin.title: Fallback margin (points above block)
fallbackMargin.description: With no handoff by block + this margin, molt writes a fallback brief from the transcript.

minRoomPercent.title: Room for a fresh session (points)
minRoomPercent.description: A seeded session gets its first warning only once its fill is this many points above its starting fill, as far as the fallback stays at 99% or below.

manualMaxMolts.title: Molts in a row without a message (manual mode)
manualMaxMolts.description: In manual mode molt pauses after this many molts with no prompt from you.

instructionsTemplate.title: Handoff instruction file
instructionsTemplate.description: What the session is told at the handoff command. Written with the default on first start; edit it freely.

warningTemplate.title: Warning file
warningTemplate.description: What the session is told at the two warnings. {{percent}}, {{stage}} and {{command}} are filled. Written with the default on first start; edit it freely.

seedTemplate.title: Seed file
seedTemplate.description: The one prompt the fresh session receives. {{path}} is the handoff. Written with the default on first start.

softPercent.title: Renamed: use commandPercent
softPercent.description: molt 0.1.0's soft threshold. Read once as commandPercent when that is unset.

hardPercent.title: Renamed: use blockPercent
hardPercent.description: molt 0.1.0's hard threshold. Read once as blockPercent when that is unset.
